description: This file is a script for processing and generating content for a roadmap project. It reads roadmap data, enriches nodes with parent information, and optionally uses OpenAI's API to generate content for roadmap topics and subtopics, saving the results as markdown files.

methods.name: writeTopicContent
methods.description: Generates a brief introduction for a given topic using OpenAI API, formatted in markdown.

methods.name: writeNodeContent
methods.description: Reads a node's markdown file, checks if it's empty, and if so, generates content for it using OpenAI or defaults to a markdown header.
